admissions.reason: Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (TEN) and Stevens-Johnson Syndrome (SJS) are part of the same spectrum of severe cutaneous adverse reactions. SJS is a more appropriate initial diagnosis given the description of "atypical targets" and "several blisters" rather than widespread epidermal detachment characteristic of TEN.
Distinct clinical entity, though related to other lupus manifestations.
Distinct clinical entity, a specific manifestation of lupus.
Distinct laboratory finding, a complication or manifestation of underlying disease.
Distinct clinical entity, a specific organ involvement in lupus.
Distinct clinical syndrome with characteristic skin lesions.
